args.message: I added up order amounts for each city within each region, then averaged those city totals so every city counts once. Cities are counted separately in each region, so Oslo appears under both North (28,939.53) and South (26,339.03). The group with no known region (null) has two "cities". One is Paris, whose customer 9002 has no region ID (677.83 from 10 orders). The other is 6 orders worth 515.47 that don't match any customer, so they have no city either; I counted them as one more city in that group. If you leave those 6 orders out, the no-region average is 677.83 for Paris alone.
